scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the January 4 hand-comfort follow-up able to include the planned tool-grip comparison, not just general discussion.
Emerging Need: The clinic confirms that the items named in a saved hand-care note are required, and one named item is away in a locked studio bin before a holiday closure.
Decision Context: The saved note identifies the green flexible rib as relevant; current calendar and messages reveal the only accessible retrieval window before the appointment.
Consequence: If the studio closes with the rib still inside, the comparison portion of the future visit is unavailable even though appointment preparation has not begun.

parameter.title: Hand-comfort follow-up with Santa Fe Hand Therapy
parameter.description: Nonurgent follow-up to review wheel and trimming comfort notes.
parameter.location: Santa Fe Hand Therapy, 612 Galisteo St

parameter.subject: Preparation note for Jan. 4 hand-comfort follow-up
parameter.body: For your January 4 hand-comfort follow-up, please bring the tool items named in your saved hand-care note plus any brief notes from recent wheel or trimming sessions. If the named tool set is not present, the therapist can still discuss general comfort but cannot do the planned grip comparison during this visit.

parameter.content: I checked the class supply cabinet and found your green flexible rib with your name tape in the locked bin. I left it there because I wasn't sure whether you wanted it at home. I'm out at 5:15 today.

parameter.title: Year-end studio checkout window
parameter.description: Final open checkout before holiday closure; supply closet and class bins available during desk coverage only.

parameter.subject: Holiday closure now in effect
parameter.body: The ceramics studio checkout desk and class supply bins are now locked for the holiday closure. Staff access resumes Tuesday, January 5 at 9:00 a.m.; no supply-bin pickups are available before then.
